task.description: Implement IDN-04 (API token management) in backend Zig and migrations according to src/design/idn-04-api-token-management.md. Deliver token issuance, secure storage (no plaintext secret persistence), listing, revocation, and validation integration for bearer auth. Ensure role claims from issued tokens interoperate with IDN-03 authorization paths. Add or update API routes and identity services/stores as designed, include required schema migration(s), and enforce security constraints and error mappings.
acceptance_criteria: IDN-04 implementation aligns with design contracts and security constraints
No SQL string interpolation of user data

result.summary: Implemented IDN-04 API token management backend: token issuance (one-time secret + SHA-256 hash persistence), metadata listing, idempotent revocation, auth middleware validation for revoked/expired tokens, and token role-claim interoperability for authorization mapping.
